3. Tolerancfis 

3.1 Tolerance on taper on gauge plane diameter O; ± IT6. 

3.2 Tolerances on dimensions without specified tolerances shall be of grade 'medium' according to 
IS: 2102*1969 ' Allowable deviations for dimensions without specified tolerances (first revision ) 


EXPLANATORY NOTE 

The dimensions specified In this standard were originally covered In IS 1 2340-1964 'Dimensions 
for self-release ( 7/24) tapers for arbors and spindle noses for milling machines' which was based on 
the draft ISO Recommendation No. 389 issued by the International Organization for Standardization. 
The revision of IS *. 2340-1964 was necessitated to bring it in line with the recent work done at the 
International level and has now been split into two separate standards. The present standard which 
covers only dimensions for spindle noses (or milling machines has been enlarged to include dimensions 
7/24 taper No. 45, 55, 65, 70, 75 and 80. 

The dimensions for 7/24 tapers for milling arbor and tool shanks are covered in IS : 2340*1972 
' Dimensions for self-release 7/24 tapers for milling arbor and tool shanks
